item.summary: Goobit Group, a listed Swedish company, is presenting Futureproof, a planned savings product that, the company says, automatically rebalances between bitcoin, gold and an interest-bearing part according to the customer's risk profile. Return figures shown for the product, such as a median return of about 25 % over three years, are the company's own calculations and have not been independently verified. Goobit says a rights issue of units is running until 5 November 2026; this is not a recommendation to subscribe and not investment advice.
